measures.name: R12 PO Quantity Cancelled
measures.expression:
VAR unk = ISBLANK(MAX('Item Branch'[Item Num 2nd])) || MAX('Item Branch'[Item Num 2nd]) = "??????"
VAR cxlLB = CALCULATE(SUM('Purchase Order Detail'[QuantityOrderedLB]) - SUM('Purchase Order Detail'[QuantityOpenLB]) - SUM('Purchase Order Detail'[QuantityReceivedLB]), NOT ISBLANK('Purchase Order Detail'[Cancel Date]))
RETURN IF(unk, 0, cxlLB + 0)

measures.name: R12 PO Ordered LBs
measures.expression:
VAR unk = ISBLANK(MAX('Item Branch'[Item Num 2nd])) || MAX('Item Branch'[Item Num 2nd]) = "??????"
VAR cxlLB = CALCULATE(SUM('Purchase Order Detail'[QuantityOrderedLB]) - SUM('Purchase Order Detail'[QuantityOpenLB]) - SUM('Purchase Order Detail'[QuantityReceivedLB]), NOT ISBLANK('Purchase Order Detail'[Cancel Date]))
RETURN IF(unk, 0, SUM('Purchase Order Detail'[QuantityOrderedLB]) - cxlLB)

measures.name: R12 PO Open LBs
measures.expression:
VAR unk = ISBLANK(MAX('Item Branch'[Item Num 2nd])) || MAX('Item Branch'[Item Num 2nd]) = "??????"
RETURN IF(unk, 0, SUM('Purchase Order Detail'[QuantityOpenLB]))

measures.name: R12 PO Spend USD
measures.expression:
VAR cxlU = CALCULATE(SUM('Purchase Order Detail'[QuantityOrdered]) - SUM('Purchase Order Detail'[QuantityOpen]) - SUM('Purchase Order Detail'[QuantityReceived]), NOT ISBLANK('Purchase Order Detail'[Cancel Date]))
RETURN IF(cxlU > 0 && SUM('Purchase Order Detail'[QuantityOpen]) + SUM('Purchase Order Detail'[QuantityReceived]) <= 0, 0, SUM('Purchase Order Detail'[AmountExtendedPrice]))

measures.name: R12 PO Purchase USD
measures.expression:
VAR cxlU = CALCULATE(SUM('Purchase Order Detail'[QuantityOrdered]) - SUM('Purchase Order Detail'[QuantityOpen]) - SUM('Purchase Order Detail'[QuantityReceived]), NOT ISBLANK('Purchase Order Detail'[Cancel Date]))
RETURN IF(cxlU > 0 && SUM('Purchase Order Detail'[QuantityOpen]) + SUM('Purchase Order Detail'[QuantityReceived]) <= 0, 0, SUM('Purchase Order Detail'[AmountExtendedPrice]))

measures.name: R12 PO Include
measures.expression: IF(MAX('Purchase Order Detail'[Scheduled Pick Date]) >= TODAY() - 365, 1, 0)

measures.name: R12 SO Ordered Quantity
measures.expression:
VAR raw = SUM('Sales'[QuantityOrdered])
VAR prim = SUM('Sales'[QuantityOrderedPrimaryUOM])
RETURN IF(MAX('Sales'[UOM]) <> MAX('Sales'[UOM Primary]) && prim = raw, 0, prim)

measures.name: R12 SO Ordered LBs
measures.expression:
VAR raw = SUM('Sales'[QuantityOrdered])
VAR prim = SUM('Sales'[QuantityOrderedPrimaryUOM])
VAR lb = SUM('Sales'[QuantityOrderedLB])
RETURN IF((MAX('Sales'[UOM]) <> MAX('Sales'[UOM Primary]) && prim = raw) || (MAX('Sales'[UOM]) <> "LB" && lb = raw), 0, lb)

measures.name: R12 SO CSR Name
measures.expression:
VAR c = MAX('CSR for Sales Orders'[CSRName])
VAR p = SEARCH(",", c, 1, 0)
RETURN IF(TRIM(c) = "", "-", IF(p = 0, c, TRIM(MID(c, p + 1, 200)) & " " & TRIM(LEFT(c, p - 1))))

measures.name: R12 SO TM Name
measures.expression:
VAR t = MAX('Territory Manager'[Mailing Name])
RETURN IF(TRIM(t) = "", "Not Available", t)

measures.name: R12 SO Delivery Instr 1
measures.expression:
VAR d = MAX('Sales'[Delivery Instructions Line 1])
RETURN IF(TRIM(d) = "", "-", d)

measures.name: R12 SO Delivery Instr 2
measures.expression:
VAR d = MAX('Sales'[Delivery Instructions Line 2])
RETURN IF(TRIM(d) = "", "-", d)

measures.name: R12 SO Make Site
measures.expression:
VAR b = MAX('Branch'[Branch Plant])
VAR st = MAX('Item Branch'[Stocking Type])
RETURN SWITCH(TRUE(), b = "CIN2" && st IN {"S","M","Q","P"}, "Kemper", b = "CIN2" && st = "D", "Shell", b = "CINC" && st IN {"S","M","Q","P"}, "Shell", "OTHER")

measures.name: R12 SO Include
measures.expression:
VAR d = MAX('Sales'[Scheduled Pick Date])
VAR gb = MAX('Item Branch'[Item Num Global Bulk])
VAR eff = IF(gb = "-" || ISBLANK(gb), MAX('Sales'[Item Num 2nd]), gb)
RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(d) && d >= TODAY() - 365 && d <= TODAY() + 30 && NOT eff IN {"IGST","CGST","SGST","CVD","ADD"} && NOT ISBLANK(MAX('CSR for Sales Orders'[CSRNum])), 1, 0)
